headline: SOVIET PILOT LANDS FIGHTER IN JAPAN, SEEKS ASYLUM
dispatch: A Soviet pilot identified as Viktor Belenko landed a MiG-25 interceptor at Hakodate yesterday and declared his intention to defect. Japanese authorities took the airman into custody while the advanced aircraft, a prized Soviet military machine, was secured for examination.
answer: Viktor Belenko defects to Japan in a MiG-25, 1976
